functions.name: BZ2_bzCompressInit
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzCompressInit ( bz_stream* strm, int blockSize100k, int verbosity, int workFactor )
functions.summary: Initialise a caller-owned bz_stream for compression: allocate the EState and three work arrays through bzalloc and enter the RUNNING state.

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Caller-owned stream. bzalloc/bzfree/opaque must be set or NULL before the call; other fields need not be initialised. Must not be moved or copied until BZ2_bzCompressEnd (back-pointer check, bzlib.c:414).

parameters.name: blockSize100k
parameters.meaning: Block size in units of 100000 bytes; also written into the stream header (compress.c:627).

parameters.name: verbosity
parameters.meaning: Diagnostic level for stderr. NOT range-checked here (bzlib.c:159-162); compared with >= thresholds 2,3,4.

parameters.name: workFactor
parameters.meaning: Effort before falling back to the fallback sort. 0 means 30 (bzlib.c:164); values above 100 behave as 100 in BZ2_blockSort (blocksort.c:1063-1064). Output is identical regardless of which sort runs.

functions.returns: BZ_OK on success, else an error code; strm->state is set only on BZ_OK.

errors.when: sizeof(int)!=4, sizeof(short)!=2 or sizeof(char)!=1 (bzlib.c:90-97, 157); checked first.
strm == NULL, blockSize100k outside 1..9, or workFactor outside 0..250 (bzlib.c:159-162).
bzalloc returned NULL for the EState (bzlib.c:169) or any work array (bzlib.c:181-187; partial allocations freed).
success.

preconditions: strm points to writable bz_stream; strm->bzalloc/bzfree are valid allocator functions or NULL.
postconditions: On BZ_OK: strm->state = new EState, mode RUNNING, sub-state INPUT, blockNo 1, combinedCRC 0 (bzlib.c:189-209).
On BZ_OK: total_in_lo32/hi32 and total_out_lo32/hi32 = 0 (bzlib.c:203-207).
next_in/avail_in/next_out/avail_out untouched.
If the parameter check passed, NULL bzalloc/bzfree have been replaced by default_bzalloc/default_bzfree in *strm (bzlib.c:165-166), even on BZ_MEM_ERROR.
On failure strm->state is unchanged.
side_effects: bzalloc(opaque, n, 1) for sizeof(EState), n*4, (n+34)*4 and 65537*4 bytes, n = 100000*blockSize100k (bzlib.c:168-179).
No I/O, no stderr output, no AssertH paths.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzCompress
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzCompress ( bz_stream* strm, int action )
functions.summary: Move data from next_in to compressed output at next_out and drive the RUNNING/FLUSHING/FINISHING/IDLE state machine (surface-area.md section 2.1).

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Stream initialised by BZ2_bzCompressInit and not ended; next_in/avail_in/next_out/avail_out describe caller buffers valid for the duration of the call (not retained).

functions.returns: A progress code (BZ_RUN_OK, BZ_FLUSH_OK, BZ_FINISH_OK, BZ_STREAM_END) or an error code. The final 'return BZ_OK' (bzlib.c:463) is unreachable.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:411-414).
RUNNING and action is BZ_RUN but no byte was consumed or produced (bzlib.c:425), e.g. avail_in == 0 with nothing pending (verified).
RUNNING and action is not BZ_RUN/BZ_FLUSH/BZ_FINISH (bzlib.c:439-440) (verified).
IDLE, i.e. after BZ_STREAM_END (bzlib.c:419-420).
FLUSHING and action != BZ_FLUSH, or avail_in differs from the value recorded at the flush request (bzlib.c:443-445).
FINISHING and action != BZ_FINISH, or avail_in changed (bzlib.c:453-455).
FINISHING and the call made no progress, e.g. avail_out == 0 while output is pending (bzlib.c:456-457) (verified).
RUNNING/BZ_RUN with progress (bzlib.c:424-425); or a flush completed, returning to RUNNING (bzlib.c:449-450), possibly in the same call that requested it (verified).
flush not yet complete (bzlib.c:447-448).
finish not yet complete (bzlib.c:458-459).
finish complete; stream now IDLE (bzlib.c:460-461), possibly in the same call that requested BZ_FINISH (verified).

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzCompressInit (passing a decompression stream is not detected and is undefined).
While FLUSHING/FINISHING, avail_in must stay exactly as the library left it (bzlib.c:444, 454).
postconditions: next_in/avail_in/total_in_* advanced by bytes consumed; next_out/avail_out/total_out_* by bytes produced.
RUNNING+BZ_FLUSH records avail_in_expect=avail_in and enters FLUSHING; RUNNING+BZ_FINISH enters FINISHING (bzlib.c:428-438).
After a completed BZ_FLUSH, fewer than 32 bits of the last block remain in the internal bit buffer; the bytes emitted so far are not independently decodable (compress.c:657-666) (verified).
side_effects: stderr output when verbosity >= 2 (per block) and >= 3/4 (details) via BZ2_compressBlock/BZ2_blockSort.
May end in BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail (exit(3)) via internal assertions 1001-1007, 2001-2002, 3001-3007; reachability not established.
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same stream concurrently; safe on distinct streams.

functions.name: BZ2_bzCompressEnd
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzCompressEnd ( bz_stream* strm )
functions.summary: Free all memory of a compression stream in any initialised state and set strm->state to NULL.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:471-474); so a second End returns BZ_PARAM_ERROR (verified).
memory released.

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzCompressInit and not yet ended.
postconditions: arr1, arr2, ftab and the EState passed to bzfree (bzlib.c:476-479); strm->state == NULL (bzlib.c:481). Other fields unchanged; pending output discarded.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzDecompressInit
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzDecompressInit ( bz_stream *strm, int verbosity, int small )
functions.summary: Initialise a caller-owned bz_stream for decompressing one stream; allocates only the DState (block arrays are allocated when the header is read).

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Caller-owned stream with bzalloc/bzfree/opaque set or NULL. Must not move until End.

parameters.name: small
parameters.meaning: 1: low-memory decoder (2.5 bytes per block byte, slower); 0: fast decoder (4 bytes per block byte) (decompress.c:211-220).

functions.returns: BZ_OK on success, else an error code.

errors.when: platform type sizes wrong (bzlib.c:499).
strm == NULL, small not 0/1, or verbosity outside 0..4 (bzlib.c:501-503) (verified).
bzalloc for the DState failed (bzlib.c:509).
success.

postconditions: On BZ_OK: strm->state = new DState with state BZ_X_MAGIC_1; totals zeroed; tt/ll16/ll4 NULL (bzlib.c:510-525).
NULL bzalloc/bzfree replaced by defaults (bzlib.c:505-506) once parameters are valid.
side_effects: One bzalloc of sizeof(DState). No I/O.
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.name: BZ2_bzDecompress
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzDecompress ( bz_stream* strm )
functions.summary: Consume compressed bytes from next_in and write decompressed bytes to next_out for exactly one bzip2 stream; checks block and combined CRCs (state machine in surface-area.md section 2.2).

parameters.name: strm
parameters.meaning: Stream initialised by BZ2_bzDecompressInit, not ended. avail_out may be 0 (not checked).

functions.returns: BZ_OK (needs more input or output space), BZ_STREAM_END, or an error code.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:812-815). No avail_out check.
stream already ended (state BZ_X_IDLE) (bzlib.c:818) (verified).
first 3 bytes not 'BZh' or 4th not '1'..'9' (decompress.c:197-208) (verified).
bzalloc of tt or ll16/ll4 failed after the header (decompress.c:216, 219).
format violation (decompress.c checks listed in surface-area.md section 8.6), block CRC mismatch (bzlib.c:830-831), combined CRC mismatch (bzlib.c:847-848), or corrupt inverse-BWT walk (bzlib.c:823).
end-of-stream marker read, combined CRC matches, all output delivered (bzlib.c:843-849).
input exhausted (decompress.c:54) or output space exhausted (bzlib.c:837-838).

preconditions: strm initialised by BZ2_bzDecompressInit; not called again after BZ_STREAM_END or an error except via BZ2_bzDecompressEnd (manual.xml:1567-1569; behaviour of further calls after errors is unspecified).
postconditions: next_in/avail_in/total_in_* and next_out/avail_out/total_out_* advanced.
On BZ_STREAM_END, bytes after the stream are not consumed: next_in points just past the byte containing the last bit of the combined CRC (verified).
Output of a block is written before its CRC is checked, so corrupt bytes may already be in next_out on BZ_DATA_ERROR.
side_effects: bzalloc once per stream when the header is read (decompress.c:211-220).
AssertH 4001 if the saved state is invalid (decompress.c:614); 4002 and 6001 unreachable (decompress.c:617, bzlib.c:855).
functions.thread_safety: Not safe on the same stream concurrently; safe on distinct streams.

functions.name: BZ2_bzDecompressEnd
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzDecompressEnd ( bz_stream *strm )
functions.summary: Free all memory of a decompression stream in any state (also after errors) and set strm->state to NULL.

errors.when: strm == NULL, strm->state == NULL, or strm->state->strm != strm (bzlib.c:865-868).
memory released.

postconditions: tt/ll16/ll4 (if non-NULL) and the DState passed to bzfree; strm->state == NULL (bzlib.c:870-875).
functions.thread_safety: Safe on distinct streams/handles; not safe on the same one concurrently. No global mutable state.

functions.summary: Create a read handle that decompresses one bzip2 stream from f, first consuming nUnused bytes copied from unused.

parameters.valid: if NULL, nUnused must be 0; if non-NULL, nUnused in 0..5000

malloc of the handle failed (bzlib.c:1113-1115) or from BZ2_bzDecompressInit.
from BZ2_bzDecompressInit (bzlib.c:1133-1135).
handle returned.

parameters.name: bzerror

parameters.name: b
parameters.meaning: Read handle whose last status is BZ_STREAM_END.

from BZ2_bzDecompress.

functions.name: BZ2_bzopen

functions.name: BZ2_bzwrite
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzwrite ( BZFILE* b, void* buf, int len )
functions.summary: fwrite-like: BZ2_bzWrite, returning len on BZ_OK and -1 otherwise.
functions.returns: len on success (0 for len == 0), -1 on any error (bzlib.c:1499-1504).

errors.when: BZ2_bzWrite status != BZ_OK.

functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzflush
functions.signature: int BZ2_bzflush ( BZFILE* b )
functions.summary: No-op: returns 0 without flushing the compressor or the FILE* (bzlib.c:1511-1512).
functions.thread_safety: Thread-safe (does nothing).

functions.name: BZ2_bzclose
functions.signature: void BZ2_bzclose ( BZFILE* b )
functions.summary: fclose-like: finish/free the handle and fclose its FILE* unless it is stdin/stdout; errors are discarded.

parameters.name: b
parameters.meaning: Handle from any open function; invalid afterwards.

postconditions: Write handle: BZ2_bzWriteClose(abandon=0); if that is not BZ_OK, BZ2_bzWriteClose(NULL, b, 1, ...) to free (bzlib.c:1524-1528).
Read handle: BZ2_bzReadClose (bzlib.c:1530).
FILE* fclose-d unless stdin/stdout (bzlib.c:1532-1534); fclose result ignored.
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_bzerror
functions.signature: const char * BZ2_bzerror ( BZFILE *b, int *errnum )
functions.summary: Return a static string for the handle's last status and store the code (positive codes mapped to 0) in *errnum.

parameters.name: errnum
parameters.meaning: Out: lastErr, or 0 if lastErr > 0; dereferenced unchecked.

functions.returns: One of "OK", "SEQUENCE_ERROR", "PARAM_ERROR", "MEM_ERROR", "DATA_ERROR", "DATA_ERROR_MAGIC", "IO_ERROR", "UNEXPECTED_EOF", "OUTBUFF_FULL", "CONFIG_ERROR" (bzlib.c:1542-1559); after BZ_STREAM_END it returns "OK" and 0 (verified).
functions.thread_safety: Not reviewed for thread safety by the authors (bzlib.h:227-234); not safe on the same handle concurrently.

functions.name: BZ2_blockSort
functions.signature: void BZ2_blockSort ( EState* s )
functions.summary: Burrows-Wheeler sort of the current compression block; sets s->origPtr. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: s
parameters.meaning: Compressor state with s->nblock > 0 block bytes in arr2 and work arrays sized as by BZ2_bzCompressInit (blocksort.c:1019-1030).

postconditions: arr1[0..nblock-1] holds sorted order; s->origPtr = index of rotation 0; ftab and arr2 beyond the block clobbered (blocksort.c:1025-1030, 1083-1088).
side_effects: fallbackSort if nblock < 10000 or main sort exceeds budget nblock*((clamp(workFactor,1,100)-1)/3) (blocksort.c:1044-1080).
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_compressBlock
functions.signature: void BZ2_compressBlock ( EState* s, Bool is_last_block )
functions.summary: Encode the current block (stream header first if blockNo == 1; end-of-stream marker, combined CRC and byte padding if is_last_block) into s->zbits/s->numZ. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: is_last_block
parameters.meaning: Non-zero to append the stream trailer.

functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_bsInitWrite
functions.signature: void BZ2_bsInitWrite ( EState* s )
functions.summary: Reset the compressor's bit buffer: s->bsLive = 0, s->bsBuff = 0 (compress.c:39-40). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_hbMakeCodeLengths
functions.signature: void BZ2_hbMakeCodeLengths ( UChar *len, Int32 *freq, Int32 alphaSize, Int32 maxLen )
functions.summary: Compute Huffman code lengths limited to maxLen by repeatedly halving weights (huffman.c:79-147). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: freq
parameters.meaning: Symbol frequencies (0 treated as 1); read only.

parameters.name: maxLen
parameters.meaning: Maximum code length; library passes 17 (compress.c:450-451). Must be large enough for alphaSize or the loop does not terminate (uncertain exact bound; unchecked).

functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_hbAssignCodes
functions.signature: void BZ2_hbAssignCodes ( Int32 *code, UChar *length, Int32 minLen, Int32 maxLen, Int32 alphaSize )
functions.summary: Assign canonical Huffman codes: by increasing length then symbol index, consecutive values, shifted left between lengths (huffman.c:160-165). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_hbCreateDecodeTables
functions.signature: void BZ2_hbCreateDecodeTables ( Int32 *limit, Int32 *base, Int32 *perm, UChar *length, Int32 minLen, Int32 maxLen, Int32 alphaSize )
functions.summary: Build canonical decoding tables limit/base/perm from code lengths (huffman.c:180-199); performs no validation. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_decompress
functions.signature: Int32 BZ2_decompress ( DState* s )
functions.summary: Resumable parser for one stream: header, block headers, tables, Huffman/MTF data, inverse-BWT setup; returns when it needs input, has a block ready (state BZ_X_OUTPUT) or reaches end of stream. Does not check CRCs. Locals are saved in s->save_* on every return except the return True inside BZ_GET_FAST/BZ_GET_SMALL at decompress.c:557-579 (apparently unreachable after the cftab checks; uncertain). Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
functions.returns: BZ_OK, BZ_STREAM_END, BZ_DATA_ERROR_MAGIC, BZ_DATA_ERROR or BZ_MEM_ERROR.
functions.thread_safety: Operates only on its arguments; same rules as the owning stream.

functions.name: BZ2_indexIntoF
functions.signature: Int32 BZ2_indexIntoF ( Int32 indx, Int32 *cftab )
functions.summary: Binary search: largest nb in 0..255 with cftab[nb] <= indx (bzlib.c:687-698). Pure. Defined __inline__ but externally visible. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.
functions.thread_safety: Pure; thread-safe.

functions.name: BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail
functions.signature: void BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail ( int errcode )
functions.summary: Fatal internal-error handler: prints a bug report message with errcode and the version to stderr (extra text for 1007) and calls exit(3) (bzlib.c:40-86). Replaced by user-supplied bz_internal_error under BZ_NO_STDIO. Not part of the public API: declared only in the private bzlib_private.h, takes private structures, not in libbz2.def.

parameters.name: errcode
parameters.meaning: Assertion number: 1001-1007 blocksort, 2001-2002 huffman, 3001-3007 compress, 4001-4002 decompress, 6001 bzlib.

side_effects: fprintf(stderr); exit(3) terminates the process without cleanup.
functions.thread_safety: Terminates the process.

data.name: BZ2_crc32Table
data.summary: Lookup table for the MSB-first CRC-32, polynomial 0x04C11DB7, used by BZ_UPDATE_CRC (bzlib_private.h:167-172) for block CRCs (CRC-32/BZIP2). Read-only in practice but not const. Not part of the public API.

data.name: BZ2_rNums
data.summary: Table of run lengths driving the XOR mask used to de-randomise blocks whose randomised bit is set (BZ_RAND_UPD_MASK, bzlib_private.h:133-149). Only used by the decoder; the compressor never randomises. Not const. Not part of the public API.

types.name: bz_stream
types.summary: Caller-allocated stream record shared by caller and library for the low-level API. Must not be moved or copied between Init and End (state->strm back-pointer is checked).

fields.name: next_in
fields.set_by: caller before each Compress/Decompress; library advances it per byte consumed
fields.meaning: Next input byte; not retained between calls.

fields.name: avail_in
fields.set_by: caller; library decrements per byte consumed
fields.meaning: Bytes available at next_in. While FLUSHING/FINISHING it must keep the value the library left (bzlib.c:444, 454).

fields.name: total_in_lo32
fields.meaning: Low 32 bits of total bytes consumed since Init.

fields.name: total_in_hi32
fields.set_by: Init (0); library increments on lo32 wrap
fields.meaning: High 32 bits of total bytes consumed.

fields.name: next_out
fields.set_by: caller; library advances per byte produced
fields.meaning: Where the next output byte goes.

fields.name: avail_out
fields.set_by: caller; library decrements per byte produced
fields.meaning: Free space at next_out (0 allowed; not checked).

fields.name: total_out_lo32
fields.meaning: Low 32 bits of total bytes produced.

fields.name: total_out_hi32
fields.set_by: Init (0); library increments on lo32 wrap
fields.meaning: High 32 bits of total bytes produced.

fields.name: state
fields.set_by: Init (new EState/DState, only on success); End sets NULL
fields.meaning: Opaque private state; NULL or foreign state gives BZ_PARAM_ERROR.

fields.name: bzalloc
fields.set_by: caller before Init; Init stores default_bzalloc (malloc) if NULL
fields.read_by: Init; BZ2_bzDecompress when reading the header
fields.meaning: Allocator, always called as bzalloc(opaque, nbytes, 1); must return NULL on failure; must stay valid until End.

fields.name: bzfree
fields.set_by: caller before Init; Init stores default_bzfree (free, skips NULL) if NULL

types.name: BZFILE
types.summary: typedef void BZFILE; opaque handle of the high-level and zlib-style APIs (absent under BZ_NO_STDIO). Points to private bzFile (bzlib.c:892-902): FILE* handle, 5000-byte buffer, writing flag, embedded bz_stream, lastErr, initialisedOk. Created by BZ2_bzReadOpen/BZ2_bzWriteOpen/BZ2_bzopen/BZ2_bzdopen; freed by BZ2_bzReadClose, a freeing BZ2_bzWriteClose[64], or BZ2_bzclose. Allocated with malloc, not bzalloc.

fields.name: handle
fields.meaning: Underlying file; closed only by BZ2_bzclose and the failure path of BZ2_bzopen/BZ2_bzdopen.

fields.name: writing
fields.meaning: Read vs write handle; mismatch gives BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR.

macros.name: BZ_RUN
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress action: compress, accept more input later.

macros.name: BZ_FLUSH
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress action: end the current block after the current avail_in bytes (up to 31 bits stay buffered).

macros.name: BZ_FINISH
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress action: compress remaining avail_in bytes and terminate the stream.

macros.name: BZ_OK
macros.summary: Success; from BZ2_bzDecompress: needs more input/output space.

macros.name: BZ_RUN_OK
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress: RUNNING with progress, or a flush completed.

macros.name: BZ_FLUSH_OK
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress: flush in progress.

macros.name: BZ_FINISH_OK
macros.summary: BZ2_bzCompress: finish in progress.

macros.name: BZ_STREAM_END
macros.summary: Compression finished, or end of compressed stream reached with good combined CRC.

macros.name: BZ_SEQUENCE_ERROR
macros.summary: Call illegal in current state (see state machines), read/write handle mismatch, or BZ2_bzReadGetUnused before end of stream.

macros.name: BZ_PARAM_ERROR
macros.summary: Bad argument (NULL, out of range, invalid stream); also BZ2_bzCompress BZ_RUN without progress and unknown action in RUNNING.

macros.name: BZ_MEM_ERROR
macros.summary: Allocation failed.

macros.name: BZ_DATA_ERROR
macros.summary: Corrupt compressed data or CRC mismatch.

macros.name: BZ_DATA_ERROR_MAGIC
macros.summary: Stream does not start with BZh1..BZh9.

macros.name: BZ_IO_ERROR
macros.summary: High-level API: ferror set, short fwrite, or fflush failure.

macros.name: BZ_UNEXPECTED_EOF
macros.summary: Input ended before the end-of-stream marker (BZ2_bzRead, BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress).

macros.name: BZ_OUTBUFF_FULL
macros.summary: Buffer utilities: output does not fit in *destLen.

macros.name: BZ_CONFIG_ERROR
macros.summary: Library miscompiled: int/short/char not 4/2/1 bytes (bzlib.c:90-97).

macros.name: BZ_MAX_UNUSED
macros.summary: Size of the high-level staging buffer; max nUnused for BZ2_bzReadOpen and max returned by BZ2_bzReadGetUnused; fread/fwrite chunk size. Only without BZ_NO_STDIO.

macros.name: BZ_NO_STDIO
macros.summary: Removes stdio: no <stdio.h>, no BZ_MAX_UNUSED/BZFILE/high-level/zlib-style functions (BZ2_bzlibVersion stays), no BZ2_bz__AssertH__fail; AssertH calls user-supplied bz_internal_error(int); verbosity output compiled out. Must be defined consistently for library and client.

macros.name: BZ_IMPORT
macros.summary: Defined by clients that load the Windows DLL dynamically (dlltest.c:10). Prevents bzlib.h from defining BZ_EXPORT, so under _WIN32 the declarations become function-pointer variables. No effect elsewhere.

macros.name: BZ_EXPORT
macros.summary: Defined by bzlib.h unless BZ_IMPORT is defined. Under _WIN32 selects BZ_API(f) = WINAPI f and BZ_EXTERN = extern (normal declarations); otherwise unused.

macros.name: BZ_API
macros.value: BZ_API(func): func (non-Windows); WINAPI func (Windows, BZ_EXPORT); (WINAPI * func) (Windows, no BZ_EXPORT)
macros.summary: Wraps each public function name in declarations and definitions; adds the __stdcall convention on Windows or turns declarations into function pointers for dynamic loading.

macros.name: BZ_EXTERN
macros.summary: Storage class prefix of each public declaration.

programs.name: bzip2
programs.summary: Block-sorting file compressor; compresses by default. Mode also derived from argv[0] (bzip2.c:1870-1880). Files: F2F name -> name.bz2 (and back via suffix map .bz2/.bz -> '', .tbz2/.tbz -> .tar, else .out); output created O_EXCL 0600 then mode/owner/times copied from input; input deleted unless -k. Decompression handles concatenated streams.
options: -f, --force: overwrite output (removed first); allow non-regular and hard-linked inputs; with -d copy non-bzip2 data through (also appends whole input after trailing garbage, see md section 9 item 18)
-s, --small: small-memory decompression; caps compression block size at 2
-L, --license, -V, --version: print version/license to stderr and continue
exit_codes: 0: success (also -h/--help)

1: bad flag, -c with -t, per-file refusals (missing/unreadable input, directory, non-regular file, existing output, hard links, already-compressed suffix, terminal I/O), over-long name, I/O error, out of memory, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP in file-to-file mode
2: data/CRC error or unexpected EOF when decompressing (immediate), not a bzip2 file (continues), any -t failure (continues), SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while decompressing/testing
3: internal panic, BZ_CONFIG_ERROR, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while compressing, libbz2 assertion (exit(3))
environment: BZIP2: whitespace-separated tokens prepended to the arguments (bzip2.c:1842)

programs.name: bunzip2
programs.summary: Copy of the bzip2 binary; name contains 'unzip', so the default is decompression (bzip2.c:1870-1872). Same options, exit codes and environment as bzip2.
options: -f, --force: overwrite output (removed first); allow non-regular and hard-linked inputs; with -d copy non-bzip2 data through (also appends whole input after trailing garbage, see md section 9 item 18)
-s, --small: small-memory decompression; caps compression block size at 2
-L, --license, -V, --version: print version/license to stderr and continue
exit_codes: 0: success (also -h/--help)

1: bad flag, -c with -t, per-file refusals (missing/unreadable input, directory, non-regular file, existing output, hard links, already-compressed suffix, terminal I/O), over-long name, I/O error, out of memory, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP in file-to-file mode
2: data/CRC error or unexpected EOF when decompressing (immediate), not a bzip2 file (continues), any -t failure (continues), SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while decompressing/testing
3: internal panic, BZ_CONFIG_ERROR, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while compressing, libbz2 assertion (exit(3))
environment: BZIP2: whitespace-separated tokens prepended to the arguments (bzip2.c:1842)

programs.name: bzcat
programs.summary: Copy of the bzip2 binary; name contains 'zcat', so the default is decompression to standard output (bzip2.c:1874-1880). Same options, exit codes and environment as bzip2.
options: -f, --force: overwrite output (removed first); allow non-regular and hard-linked inputs; with -d copy non-bzip2 data through (also appends whole input after trailing garbage, see md section 9 item 18)
-s, --small: small-memory decompression; caps compression block size at 2
-L, --license, -V, --version: print version/license to stderr and continue
exit_codes: 0: success (also -h/--help)

1: bad flag, -c with -t, per-file refusals (missing/unreadable input, directory, non-regular file, existing output, hard links, already-compressed suffix, terminal I/O), over-long name, I/O error, out of memory, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP in file-to-file mode
2: data/CRC error or unexpected EOF when decompressing (immediate), not a bzip2 file (continues), any -t failure (continues), SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while decompressing/testing
3: internal panic, BZ_CONFIG_ERROR, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS while compressing, libbz2 assertion (exit(3))
environment: BZIP2: whitespace-separated tokens prepended to the arguments (bzip2.c:1842)

programs.name: bzip2recover
programs.summary: Standalone (no libbz2) recovery tool: scans damaged_file bit by bit for block and end-of-stream magics and writes each block of >= 130 bits as a single-block stream rec%05d<basename>[.bz2] (header always BZh9, combined CRC = block CRC) next to the input, created O_EXCL 0600.
options: exactly one argument: the damaged file name (< 1980 characters)
exit_codes: 0: success
1: wrong argument count, name too long, unreadable input, no blocks found, 49999 block/end magic matches (BZ_MAX_HANDLED_BLOCKS 50000), read/write/malloc error, output file already exists

programs.name: bzgrep
programs.summary: sh script: runs grep over 'bzip2 -cdfq' of each file (or stdin), prefixing file names when several files; tries FILE.bz2 if FILE is missing.
options: grep options before the pattern are passed through; -e/-f take the pattern, -A/-B take an argument
exit_codes: 1: no pattern (usage)
otherwise grep's status (stdin) or the last non-zero grep status, else 0

programs.name: bzegrep
programs.summary: Symlink to bzgrep; name ends in 'egrep', so the matcher is ${EGREP-egrep} (bzgrep:13).
exit_codes: as bzgrep

programs.name: bzfgrep
programs.summary: Symlink to bzgrep; name ends in 'fgrep', so the matcher is ${FGREP-fgrep} (bzgrep:14).
exit_codes: as bzgrep

programs.name: bzmore
programs.summary: sh script: pages 'bzip2 -cdfq' of each file (or of stdin if it is not a terminal) through more, prompting between files (e/q quit, s skip).
exit_codes: not explicitly defined; determined by the shell's exit trap (uncertain)

programs.name: bzless
programs.summary: Symlink to bzmore; name ends in 'less', so the pager is less (bzmore:10).
exit_codes: as bzmore

programs.name: bzdiff
programs.summary: sh script: runs diff on one or two files, decompressing *.bz2 operands with bzip2 -cdfq (one file F compares F.bz2 with F; two .bz2 files use a mktemp file).
options: arguments starting with - are passed to the comparator; 1 or 2 existing regular files
exit_codes: 1: missing/non-regular file, no files, more than two files, mktemp failure
otherwise the comparator's status

programs.name: bzcmp
programs.summary: Symlink to bzdiff; name ends in 'cmp', so the comparator is ${CMP-cmp} (bzdiff:18).
exit_codes: as bzdiff
